turns.assessment: The simultaneous, network-wide onset includes many OCH_LOS and client failures, while two different outgoing OMSs from S06 report amplifier input LOS. All affected working paths share roadm.S06, and unaffected nearby optical instrumentation argues against a broad fibre or amplifier fault elsewhere. A failed WSS input port at S06 can block the common arriving channel set and remove those channels from multiple outgoing degrees, matching the pattern.

proposals.rationale: roadm.S06 is the sole stated common dependency. A WSS input-port failure there explains simultaneous loss of many channels and services and the AMP_INPUT_LOS alarms on multiple S06 outgoing lines.

clarify.assessment: The evidence localizes the failure to a WSS input port at roadm.S06, but it does not identify the incoming degree. The simultaneous downstream losses are compatible with any of the four listed ports, and the unchanged monitors on some incoming sections do not distinguish them because a WSS port failure occurs after those measurements.

llm_alone.decision: commit not to one place (4 locations); reported as a set

score.why: truth not in the reported set
